name: Watts Up
tagline: Peer-to-peer EV charging: residents rent out private chargers, with QR check-in and maps.
problem: Public stations are crowded while private chargers sit idle.
solution: A sharing platform with provider and customer pages, maps and QR-code charging sessions.
demo_moment: Team-described: find a neighbour's charger and start a session by QR.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Environmental Hack” and “Powering Tomorrow” among 134 submissions.
Won both the environmental category and the EV challenge.

lessons: A two-sided sharing model reads as both green and viable.
